business_problem: Grupo Dreamers had 20 companies using fragmented AI tools and tech contracts without central governance, which trapped knowledge in silos and created legal, reputational, and IP risk from employees putting sensitive client data into unmanaged free AI services.
solution_summary: Grupo Dreamers standardized its internal AI stack on Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise so employees across more than 20 media and entertainment businesses could move from shadow AI to a governed enterprise platform. The rollout uses native Gemini integration inside Gmail, Google Docs, Google Slides, and Google Meet, allowing teams to adopt AI through familiar collaboration tools instead of separate consumer apps. Access is structured in tiers: all employees receive productivity and summarization support, business specialists use advanced strategic research and multimodal creation, and engineering teams use the platform for deeper reasoning and code automation. The group also built an enablement model through Projeto Aurora and Academia Dreamers so knowledge, prompts, and automation patterns remain inside the holding. This architecture ties secure AI usage back to the group's existing Google Cloud data infrastructure and replaces fragmented tooling with one managed operating model.
